name: Sera Hidetaka
source: He's well-known for his engaging lectures that teach how to learn English like a native speaker. He takes care to understand each students needs. He's always striving to be a better teacher. He is the charming and popular teacher at school, but once you unmask him, you discover a hidden dark side... When you approach him with an open heart, will you stumble across the truth behind his smile...?
